content.tex: INVESTIGATION ESTIMATING \(\pi\)
This investigation is about using relative frequency to estimate the value of \(\pi\) .
Area of rectangle \(=\) length \(\times\) width. Area, A, of circle radius \(r\) is A\(= \pi r^{2}\) .
Lee draws circles on rectangular pieces of paper. He drops grains of rice at random onto the pieces of paper. He counts the number of grains of rice inside each circle.

parts.text: Lee draws a circle of radius 5 cm on a rectangular piece of paper measuring 40 cm by 20 cm.

content.tex: Lee draws a circle of radius 5cm on a rectangular piece of paper measuring 40cm by 20cm.
Find the area of the rectangle.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The probability, p , that a grain of rice lands inside the circle is p = area of circle area of rectangle . The area of the circle is 25 × π . Show that p is approximately 0.098 for this piece of paper.

content.tex: The probability, \(p\) , that a grain of rice lands inside the circle is
\(p = \frac{area of circle}{area of rectangle}\) .
The area of the circle is \(25 \times \pi\) .
Show that \(p\) is approximately 0.098 for this piece of paper.

parts.text: (d) The relative frequency that a grain of rice is inside the circle gives an estimate for the probability, p . The area of the circle is 25 × π . Use area of circle area of rectangle = 0.15 to show that an estimate for π is 4.8 .

The area of the circle is \(25 \times \pi\) .
Use \(\frac{area of circle}{area of rectangle} = 0.15\) to show that an estimate for \(\pi\) is 4.8 .
